historic_pathology.note: Catalog MEMORY cites 23×65=2037. 23×65=1495; 2037 is the remembered process-table size (sessions×servers plus other children). This unit does not re-measure that Windows box. It reproduces the multiplication class (N sessions → N stdio children) and the shared-HTTP collapse (N sessions → 1 child) on this Linux worktree with a stub server.

policy: EAGER_STDIO is the negative control: one child per (session, server)
SHARED_HTTP and LAZY_SHARED keep one child per server_id
LAZY_SHARED does not spawn on open_session, only on first use
a dead shared child raises SharedServerDeadError immediately
call() polls the child before I/O and does not restart it
pass/fail is /proc cmdline and ps RSS, not the pool dict
never resolve a hang by killing a shared service (IMP-0066)
